notes:
Summary: mid-market analytics platform building in-product semantic search and recommendations. Starting with Hosted API evaluation; likely to move to Dedicated once throughput and cost profile validated.

Key contacts: CPO - Lena Ortiz (primary), Eng Lead - Ryan Cho, Data Eng - Maya Patel. AE: Marco DeLuca. SE: Priya Menon.

Requirements / priorities:
- Workload: nightly batch ingest (~100k new docs/day), real-time semantic search for product UX (expected 50-150 qps peak), embeddings for personalization.
- Latency: target 80-120ms p95 for semantic search at 100 qps. Some pages can accept up to 250ms.
- Throughput: batch jobs must finish within maintenance window (2-3 hours) without blowing egress budgets.
- Vector DB: currently trialing Milvus in-house for POC, but open to managed vector DB to reduce Ops. Need clear guidance on egress and storage costs with Redwood + Pinecone/managed alternatives.
- Model preferences: open models (Llama2/Redwood-verified variants) for cost predictability; willing to consider higher-accuracy checkpoints for reranking.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, and EU data residency for EU customers.

What we've done so far:
- 2026-01-25: Intro call (Marco) — high-level product fit, KRs for POC.
- 2026-02-05: Technical deep-dive (Priya) — provided architecture notes, discussed batching and KV cache.
- 2026-02-12: Fireflies meeting (ff_2026-02-12_3311) — agreed to attempt Hosted API POC first.
- 2026-03-02: Hosted API demo & latency walkthrough (ff_2026-03-02_4492). Eng team ran sample queries against Redwood-hosted embeddings.
- 2026-03-10: Sent POC scope and sample data; Data Eng asked for nightly batch ingest sizing guidance.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need predictable unit cost for embeddings — bursts kill our margins." — Lena O.
- "If we can get sub-100ms p95 at 100 qps with 1/3 of current token spend, we'll move to dedicated." — Ryan C.

Open technical questions (from SE session):
- How does Redwood handle large nightly batch uploads? Need recommended batch chunking, parallelization guidance, and expected CPU/GPU hours estimate.
- Egress pricing when using external vector DB vs Redwood-managed storage.
- Fallback strategy: acceptable model variants to degrade to if Dedicated capacity saturated.

Next steps (short):
- Fieldstone to start 2-week Hosted API POC with subset of product queries (start 2026-03-15).
- Redwood SE to provide batch job runbook + cost estimate (by 2026-03-14).
- Schedule pricing + Dedicated sizing call with Finance and Infrastructure (target week of 2026-03-22).

Deal dynamics / notes for AE:
- Price-sensitive: finance will push back on per-embedding egress; prefer capped committed usage.
- Path: Hosted API -> Dedicated commit (6-12 months) if POC meets latency/throughput and cost.
- Champion: Lena Ortiz — cares about UX latency and predictable TCO.

Attachments: POC scope doc (drive:/deals/Fieldstone/POC-scope-v2.md), Security FAQ (drive:/security/Fieldstone-Security-FAQ.pdf).
